supplement.lead: 2024年10月，美国常春藤名校康乃尔大学（Cornell University）发生一宗校园集体性侵案。一名当时20岁的女学生指称，她在酒精和药物影响下，于 Chi Phi 兄弟会康乃尔分会（Xi Chapter）的宿舍内，遭七名兄弟会成员轮流性侵数小时。事后她向校警报案，校方展开调查，对涉案学生作出包括开除和停学在内的处分；检方则以「证据不足」为由，没有提出刑事指控；她其后退学。
body: 2024年10月，美国常春藤名校康乃尔大学（Cornell University）发生一宗校园集体性侵案。一名当时20岁的女学生指称，她在酒精和药物影响下，于 Chi Phi 兄弟会康乃尔分会（Xi Chapter）的宿舍内，遭七名兄弟会成员轮流性侵数小时。
事后她向校警报案，校方展开调查，对涉案学生作出包括开除和停学在内的处分；检方则以「证据不足」为由，没有提出刑事指控；
她其后退学。今年9月，她以「Jane Doe」的化名 提起民事诉讼 ，控告七名涉案学生、康乃尔大学、兄弟会和她自己所属姊妹会的相关组织，以及事发前她到过的酒吧，要求针对此事造成的身心伤害给予赔偿。这宗沉寂近两年的案件，由此重回公众视野。

headline.title: French police suspend use of stun grenades at school protests as minister rejects accusations of brutality
headline.lead: Minister says use of grenades has been stopped after a student lost a hand as protests across France continue How dilapidated are French schools and how bad is
body: Minister says use of grenades has been stopped after a student lost a hand as protests across France continue How dilapidated are French schools and how bad is inequality in the education system?

France’s interior minister has suspended the use of stun grenades by police at high school demonstrations but rejected mounting accusations of police brutality during two weeks of protests marred by often violent clashes that have injured hundreds.

Laurent Nuñez told RTL radio on Wednesday that he had ordered a temporary halt on the use of the grenades “in the context of the high school students’ movement” after a 15-year-old boy lost a hand during a protest in Lens, northern France, on Monday. Continue reading...
